description: SPENDS credits: discovers the original request, then buys ONE audio piece (eleven_music, eleven_sfx, voiceover with a vetted voice — Aria, Sarah, Laura, Roger, George, Charlie; default Aria — or soundtrack). Read soclo_audio_quote first and pass its exact expectedCredits and pricingVersion so a moved price refuses uncharged. M4 approval flow: show the owner the storyboard (soclo_host_plan_state) and the quote, and get their yes before a paid make; if the owner says "just make it", you may proceed through the remaining approved makes within the SAME ceilings without re-asking each piece, and a changed price still stops for a fresh yes. Always supply one stable clientRequestId per purchase and keep it: an unknown outcome is reconciled under the SAME id with soclo_audio_recover — do not start a new paid request and do not mint a replacement id to bypass a duplicate. A duplicate_request refusal means the earlier attempt was charged: never report it as not charged. Re-takes and edits afterwards: change the script or description, re-read the quote, and make with a NEW clientRequestId; the exact debit for any submitted piece is confirmed in soclo_wallet, never assumed free. A make returns the poll handles (requestId, statusUrl, responseUrl, receiptId): pass them unchanged to soclo_audio_poll until the finished audio is returned.

clientRequestId.description: Required for make and ID-only recover: persist one stable ID per purchase before submission. Recover that same ID after a lost acknowledgement; do not mint a replacement.

duration.description: For eleven-metered makes, within the quoted model’s own range: eleven_music 3-600 seconds; eleven_sfx 0.5-22 seconds. Fractional seconds are fine (MAIN prices music per started minute). Use the value you quoted.

expectedCredits.description: Required for every make: the exact figure from the server quote. Zero is valid only when the server quotes zero; MAIN revalidates the price.

model.description: eleven_music / eleven_sfx are server-quoted and metered; voiceover / soundtrack are flat-credit recipes.

ownerApprovedPrice.description: Required true for make only after the owner has seen the quote/flat price and said yes (or said "just make it" for this run).

pricingVersion.description: Required for every make: from the quote.

prompt.description: For make: the music/SFX description, or the exact spoken line(s) for voiceover.

voice.description: For voiceover: a vetted voice; defaults to Aria.

name: soclo_audio_make
title: Make one audio piece
